# Pin types for icon packs

<!-- Generated by tools/cmf_pin_types.py from tools/cmf_pin_types.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

These are the pin type names the 5.01 world map uses, as the second argument of `CMFRegisterIcon`, `CMFRegisterLegendIcon` and `CMFRegisterTint` (write them as names, in single quotes: `'Innkeeper'`). Names are case-sensitive.

Columns: **Stock art** says the map has a stock glyph for that name (one frame of the pin sprite). **API version 1** says whether a claim on that name changes anything today: *yes*; *use base* (register the base name instead); *no* (API version 1 never sees that pin); *unverified* (the map has a glyph but vanilla 5.01 was not seen sending that type; it may come from quests or other mods).

Source: the pin sprite and legend table of the pinned 5.01 map (pin sprite SHA-256 `d9b5f0daff36ed8e`, legend table digest `25d8e7c015ca126f`), plus CMF notes from reading vanilla `mapMenu.ws`. Names only; no game code is stored. 162 names.

| `Transport` | yes | yes |  |
